description: integrations.sh is an open registry of integration surfaces for other services. It catalogs APIs, GraphQL endpoints, MCP servers, and CLIs by domain and provides discovery endpoints for developers and AI agents.
summary: integrations.sh exposes two public developer surfaces on its own domain: a REST API at `https://integrations.sh/api` and a streamable-HTTP MCP server at `https://integrations.sh/mcp`; no credentials are required.
